engine.summary: Metaheuristic search (genetic algorithm, simulated annealing), exposed over WebAssembly as solvers of a travelling-salesman tour through 2D points.

surfaces.name: u-metaheur
surfaces.note: The crate is a framework: GA, BRKGA, SA, ALNS, CP, tabu and VNS runners over a problem the caller implements as a trait; the two WebAssembly operations are its runners applied to one fixed problem.
surfaces.error_shape: Err(ConfigError) from a runner given settings it cannot run.

surfaces.name: @iyulab/u-metaheur
surfaces.note: Objects in and out, typed in the .d.ts (GaConfig, GaResult, SaConfig, SaResult). Bundler and Node targets; no bundler-less browser build.
surfaces.error_shape: A thrown Error whose code property is the code, with the fields (parameter, index, min, max, got, ...) as its other properties.

errors.shape: A refusal carries a stable snake_case 'code' and the fields listed for that code; only the WebAssembly surface refuses with codes.

source.catalog: code_catalog in src/wasm.rs, built from the Code table the refusals are made from; published as codes() in WebAssembly. What each code means is tabled in README.md, which a test holds equal to the catalog.

operations.summary: A short closed tour through 2D points by a genetic algorithm: order crossover, swap mutation, tournament selection, a nearest-neighbour tour in the first population; returns the best tour, its length, the generations run and why it stopped.

effects.note: A run draws from config.seed when it is given and from fresh entropy when it is not; config.time_limit_ms ends it at a wall-clock deadline.

determinism.note: The worst case, a run without config.seed. stop_reason says which limit ended a run.

cases.when: config.seed given and no config.time_limit_ms: the run ends on its own generation budget

cases.note: How far the search gets before the deadline depends on machine speed; with the same seed it visits the same candidates in the same order.

output_provenance.note: Whether the run used its whole generation budget or stopped at the deadline.

limits: Tour quality has not been compared against optimal tours of standard instances (TSPLIB).

performance.complexity: O(generations · population_size · n) for n points.

operations.summary: A short closed tour through 2D points by simulated annealing from the nearest-neighbour tour: 2-opt moves, geometric cooling (T multiplied by cooling_rate per move); returns the best tour, its length, the iterations run and why it stopped.

effects.note: A run draws from config.seed when it is given and from fresh entropy when it is not; config.time_limit_ms ends it at a wall-clock deadline.

determinism.note: The worst case, a run without config.seed. stop_reason says which limit ended a run.

cases.when: config.seed given and no config.time_limit_ms: the run ends on its own iteration budget or once the temperature has cooled to nothing

cases.note: How far the search gets before the deadline depends on machine speed; with the same seed it visits the same candidates in the same order.

output_provenance.note: Whether the run used its iterations, cooled to nothing first, or stopped at the deadline.

limits: Tour quality has not been compared against optimal tours of standard instances (TSPLIB).

performance.complexity: O(iterations · n) for n points : each 2-opt move copies and re-measures the tour.
